# Mixed Content Collection

> > A diverse collection covering AI video editing tools (Vidnoz, CapCut, Renderforest), TV entertainment guides (TV Guide listings for Netflix, Peacock, HBO), and reference materials.

This collection appears to aggregate content from multiple domains, primarily focusing on Spanish-language AI video editing platforms and English-language TV/streaming entertainment guides. The AI video tools emphasize text-to-video generation, auto-subtitles, and social media optimization, while TV Guide content covers streaming recommendations and live sports schedules.

## AI Video Editing Tools

- [Deevid AI - Editor de Video con IA](https://deevid.ai/es/ai-video-editor): AI video editor with text commands, automation, and workflows
- [VEED.IO - Editor de Video IA](https://veed.io/es-ES): AI video editor with auto-subtitles, avatars, and collaboration features
- [Vidnoz - Crea Videos con IA](https://es.vidnoz.com): AI video generator with realistic avatars and voice cloning, 10x faster
- [CapCut - Editor de Video de IA](https://capcut.com/es-es): AI video editor for YouTube and Instagram with smart templates
- [Invideo - Editor de Video con IA Gratuito](https://invideo.io/es/crear/video-editor-ia): AI editor creates videos from text prompts with automatic scripts
- [Kapwing - Editor de Video con IA](https://kapwing.com/es-es/ai): AI video editor with auto-editing and platform optimization
- [Clipchamp - Edición de Vídeo con IA](https://clipchamp.com/es/ai-video-editing-clipchamp): AI video editor with auto-compose and voice-over features
- [Renderforest - Editor de Video con IA](https://renderforest.com/es/ai-video-editor): AI video editor from prompt to polished video in minutes
- [Vmaker - Editor de Videos con IA](https://vmaker.com/es/ai-video-editor): Award-winning AI editor with 25 features, transforms raw footage to publish-ready
